definitions.explanation: Describes two or more things happening in an alternating pattern, taking turns one after another.

examples.japanese: {左右|さゆう}{交互|こうご}に{足|あし}を{上|あ}げる。
examples.english: Raise your legs alternately, left and right.

examples.japanese: {赤|あか}と{白|しろ}の{花|はな}を{交互|こうご}に{植|う}えた。
examples.english: I planted red and white flowers alternately.

examples.japanese: この{曲|きょく}では、ピアノとバイオリンが{交互|こうご}にメロディーを{奏|かな}でる{構成|こうせい}になっている。
examples.english: In this piece, the piano and violin take turns playing the melody.

notes:
USAGE:
The base word {交互|こうご} is a noun/na-adjective meaning 'alternation.' The adverbial form {交互|こうご}に is the most common usage. Describes a regular back-and-forth pattern between two or more elements.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {交互|こうご}に{繰|く}り{返|かえ}す (repeat alternately)
- {交互|こうご}に{並|なら}べる (arrange alternately)
- {交互|こうご}に{行|おこな}う (do in turns)
- {左右|さゆう}{交互|こうご}に (alternating left and right)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {代|か}わる{代|が}わる: in turn/one after another — emphasizes people taking turns; more colloquial
- {順番|じゅんばん}に: in order/in sequence — follows a set order, not necessarily alternating
